zh.title: 旧 Kindle 做信息屏：先选内容，再核对固件
zh.intro: Home Assistant、WHOOP 和桌面用量看板需要不同的外部服务。墨水屏是显示端，不能据此判断设备在本地运行 AI。

seo.title: 旧 Kindle 再利用：做墨水屏信息看板 | 二手硬件再就业指南 · KitAgain
seo.description: 把旧 Kindle 再利用为 Home Assistant 或信息看板；开始前核对准确型号、固件、越狱路径、刷新方式和恢复条件，并验证断网与数据过期状态。

sections: 先检查手里的设备
记下准确型号和固件，先查相应 jailbreak 指南；WinterBreak 是前置工具，不是成品看板。
Kindle 4 的 HA 示例不能证明任意 Paperwhite 可用；WHOOP 作者验证范围是 PW2 / 5.10.3。
先保存设备文件与配置备份，明确移除脚本与撤销 jailbreak 是不同步骤。
按内容选择路线
已有 Home Assistant：查看服务端截图＋Kindle 显示的路线，分别排查页面权限、截图和拉取。
已有 WHOOP 数据：查看账户/API、KUAL/linkss 与唤醒链路；一次周期成功不代表数周续航。
桌面 AI 工具用量：Kindle Dashboard 需要 Windows 10/11 主机及 SSH/FBInk；显示用量不等于运行模型。
想切换多类内容：Kindle Carousel 的文档以 Kindle 3 / 4 NT 为范围，持续按键监听会影响续航。
开始前的最低验证
先手动显示一张正确尺寸的图，再安排刷新和唤醒。
模拟断网、认证失效和数据过期，避免屏幕静默展示旧状态。
记录数日耗电、刷新失败与恢复；额外主机和服务尚未核价。以下项目页保留原始依据，本专题没有新增硬件实测。

en.title: Old Kindle displays: choose the content, then check firmware
en.intro: Home Assistant, WHOOP and desktop usage dashboards need different external services. An e-ink display endpoint is not evidence of AI running locally.

seo.title: Reuse an Old Kindle as an E-Ink Dashboard | KitAgain
seo.description: Reuse an old Kindle as a Home Assistant or information dashboard. Check the exact model, firmware, jailbreak path, refresh method, and recovery before setup.

sections: Check the device you own
Record the exact model and firmware, then check its jailbreak guide. WinterBreak is a prerequisite tool, not a finished dashboard.
A Kindle 4 Home Assistant example does not establish support for every Paperwhite. The WHOOP author's verified scope is PW2 / 5.10.3.
Back up device files and configuration. Removing scripts and undoing a jailbreak are separate steps.
Choose by content
Already use Home Assistant: compare server-side screenshots with Kindle display, checking page permissions, rendering and retrieval separately.
Already have WHOOP data: check account/API, KUAL/linkss and wake behavior. One completed cycle does not prove weeks of battery life.
Desktop AI usage: Kindle Dashboard needs a Windows 10/11 host and SSH/FBInk. Displaying usage is not running a model.
Switchable content: Kindle Carousel documents Kindle 3 / 4 NT. Continuous button listening affects battery life.
Minimum checks before continuous use
Display a correctly sized image manually before scheduling refresh and wake.
Simulate disconnection, expired authentication and stale data so outdated information is not silently presented.
Record several days of power use, failed refreshes and recovery. Hosts and service costs are not priced. Linked project pages preserve original evidence; this guide adds no hardware testing.

zh.title: 旧音箱接 AI：桥接、刷机和换板是三条路
zh.intro: 先决定是否接受厂商云依赖、拆机与外部主机，再选择适合自己音箱的路径。
sections: 保留原固件：服务桥接
XiaoGPT 把请求交给外部模型，README 给出 LX06 配置示例；仍依赖小米账号和语音接口。
先完成一次问答并测试停止桥接后原功能是否正常；不能据此承诺所有小爱音箱都兼容。
接管音频：型号限定的补丁固件
Open-XiaoAI 区分 LX06 和 OH2P，拆机方式与连接线不同，不能互套镜像。
仓库已归档。双分区回退依赖原分区完好，必须先准备备份与恢复资料。
复用外壳与扬声器：替换主板
Onju 使用第二代 Nest Mini 与替换 PCB，不是给原 Google 固件装一个应用。
原版已停止积极维护，v2 是同一家族后继；早期演示不是所有 v2 功能的证明。
若手里是通用 Linux 设备，可另看 Linux Voice Assistant，但音频驱动、架构和 Home Assistant 服务仍需核对。
共通的验收条件
音频输入、播放、网络和模型后端分别验证，再测完整对话与重启。
断网或后端失效时应能判断失败。保留原主板或可回退配置。
常开主机、PCB、语音和模型服务可能产生成本，当前金额未知；本站没有实机或延迟测试。

en.title: AI on old speakers: bridging, flashing and board replacement
en.intro: Decide whether you accept vendor-cloud dependence, disassembly and an external host before choosing a route for your speaker.
sections: Keep original firmware: service bridging
XiaoGPT forwards requests to an external model and documents an LX06 configuration. Xiaomi accounts and voice interfaces remain dependencies.
Complete one exchange, then stop the bridge and check original functions. This does not establish compatibility with all XiaoAI speakers.
Take over audio: model-specific patched firmware
Open-XiaoAI distinguishes LX06 and OH2P, with different disassembly and cables. Do not interchange their images.
The repository is archived. Dual-partition rollback depends on the original partition being intact; prepare backups and recovery documentation first.
Reuse enclosure and speaker: replace the motherboard
Onju combines a second-generation Nest Mini with a replacement PCB. It is not an app installed on original Google firmware.
The original is no longer actively maintained; v2 is a successor in the same family. Earlier demos do not prove all v2 features.
For generic Linux hardware, also consider Linux Voice Assistant, checking audio drivers, architecture and Home Assistant services.
Shared acceptance checks
Verify audio input, playback, network and model backend separately, then test complete conversations and rebooting.
Recognize network/backend failures. Keep the original board or a configuration that can be rolled back.
Always-on hosts, PCBs, voice and model services may cost money. Amounts are unknown; this site has no hardware or latency tests.

zh.title: 旧小主机放在家里：自动化、存储还是媒体？
zh.intro: 先选一个明确用途，再检查启动方式、存储健康和备份。安装系统并不自动增加算力。
sections: 家庭自动化
HAOS 适合可专用的 x86-64 UEFI 主机。官方 Generic 路径要求关闭 Secure Boot，并核对 512n/512e；不能只看 64 位 CPU。
写入会覆盖目标磁盘。连接一个真实设备并演练备份恢复后，再考虑长期使用。
局域网存储
OpenMediaVault 需要规划系统盘、数据盘和独立备份；旧硬盘健康是单独的问题。
README 说明系统需要独占 OS 配置，不应将它当作可任意容器化或并装桌面的普通应用。RAID 不替代备份。
轻量服务、影音或游戏
DietPi 先检查目标设备是否有映像、架构与 RAM 是否满足；不保证任意旧板都适配。
LibreELEC 是专用 Kodi 系统，需要当前映像与硬件匹配；DRM 服务另行核查。
Batocera 可考虑外置启动，内部安装前仍需备份；性能受硬件限制，系统不提供游戏版权授权。
选择时记录什么
启动方式、磁盘逻辑扇区、网络与外设支持，以及重启后的状态。
电力、噪声、磁盘与附件支出由实际设备决定，本目录没有测量值或价格。
先用外置介质或备份降低切换成本；以下链接提供各路线的原始文档和限制。

en.title: An old mini PC at home: automation, storage or media?
en.intro: Choose one clear job, then check boot mode, storage health and backups. Installing an OS does not add computing power.
sections: Home automation
HAOS suits a dedicated x86-64 UEFI host. The official Generic route requires Secure Boot disabled and checks for 512n/512e storage; a 64-bit CPU alone is not enough.
Writing the image overwrites the target disk. Connect a real device and practice backup restoration before long-term use.
LAN storage
OpenMediaVault needs a plan for the OS disk, data disks and an independent backup. Old-disk health is a separate issue.
The README says it needs exclusive control over OS configuration. Do not treat it as an ordinary app to containerize or install alongside a desktop. RAID does not replace backups.
Light services, media or games
For DietPi, check available images, architecture and RAM. Not every old board is supported.
LibreELEC is a dedicated Kodi OS requiring a matching current image. Verify DRM services separately.
Batocera offers external boot options; internal installation still needs backups. Hardware limits performance, and the OS grants no game copyright permissions.
What to record when choosing
Boot mode, disk logical sectors, networking/peripheral support and behavior after reboot.
Power, noise, disks and accessories depend on the actual device. This catalog has no measurements or prices.
Use external media or backups to reduce switching costs. The linked project pages provide original documentation and route-specific limits.

zh.intro: 先分清设备是智能电视还是电视盒，再核对芯片、固件与恢复路径；同名外壳和相近型号不能证明镜像兼容。

seo.title: 旧电视与电视盒再利用：媒体系统或 Linux | 二手硬件再就业指南 · KitAgain
seo.description: 比较旧电视与电视盒的 LibreELEC、CoreELEC、Armbian 和 webOS 路线；先核对准确型号、芯片、固件、外置启动与恢复条件。

sections: 先确认设备类型
电视盒路线通常依赖 SoC、主板、内存、网卡与设备树；商品名相同也可能更换内部硬件。
webOS 电视路线依赖具体固件和已公开入口；旧漏洞已修复时，不要把历史教程当作当前可用方案。
媒体系统还是小服务器
LibreELEC 与 CoreELEC 都是专用媒体系统；先在各自支持范围内找准确设备与当前镜像。
Armbian 盒子路线应先从 USB 或存储卡启动，确认网络和存储，再考虑写入 eMMC。
HK1 Box 仅在上游设备表与板型、设备树都匹配时继续；收录不等于 KitAgain 实机验证。
开始前的最低检查
保存原厂固件、分区或原主板，并找到与准确硬件版本对应的恢复资料。
分别验证启动、显示、网络、遥控、存储和重启；一项失败不能由其他项目的成功记录替代。
本站没有补充功耗、性能、DRM 或长期稳定性测试；未知项继续保持未知。

en.title: Reuse old TVs and TV boxes: media, web apps, or Linux?
en.intro: First distinguish a smart TV from a TV box, then match the chipset, firmware, and recovery path. Similar names and enclosures do not establish image compatibility.

seo.title: Reuse Old TVs & TV Boxes: Media or Linux? | KitAgain
seo.description: Compare LibreELEC, CoreELEC, Armbian, and webOS routes for old TVs and TV boxes; verify the exact model, chipset, firmware, boot path, and recovery first.

sections: Identify the device type first
TV-box routes depend on the SoC, board, memory, network hardware, and device tree. The same retail name may hide changed internals.
webOS TV routes depend on exact firmware and a documented entry point. Do not treat a historical exploit as current when later firmware patched it.
Choose media OS or small server
LibreELEC and CoreELEC are dedicated media systems; locate the exact device and a current image within each project's stated scope.
For an Armbian box route, boot from USB or removable storage and verify networking and storage before considering eMMC installation.
Continue with HK1 Box only when the upstream device table, board, and device tree match. Inclusion is not a KitAgain hardware test.
Minimum checks before changing it
Preserve stock firmware, partitions, or the original board, and find recovery material for the exact hardware revision.
Test boot, display, network, remote, storage, and reboot separately. A success report for another box cannot replace a failed check.
This guide adds no power, performance, DRM, or long-term stability tests; unsupported facts remain unknown.

seo.title: 旧路由器刷 OpenWrt 前先核对恢复 | 二手硬件再就业指南 · KitAgain
seo.description: 比较旧路由器的 OpenWrt 与 FreshTomato 路线，并从 Xiaomi 型号线索继续核对硬件修订、首次安装、分区布局、备份与恢复条件。

sections: 先找到准确配置档
记录底部标签、地区版本与硬件修订，再到上游支持表或固件选择器定位准确配置档。
Xiaomi AX9000、AX3000T、4A Gigabit 与 Redmi AX6S 是不同目标；不能因品牌相同而互换镜像。
区分升级与首次安装
sysupgrade、factory、initramfs 等文件承担不同用途；只按准确设备页的首次安装说明操作。
社区汇总适合发现型号，但不能替代官方设备 Info、分区布局、引导方式与恢复步骤。
FreshTomato 只适用于其支持表内设备；没有列出型号时不要据此推断可用。
先准备恢复，再判断用途
保存原厂配置与必要分区，确认救援模式、串口或厂商恢复工具确实适用于该修订。
先验证有线网络、管理入口、重启和回滚，再考虑拨号、无线或附加服务。
本站没有对吞吐、覆盖、功耗或长期稳定性做实机比较。

en.title: Reuse an old router: verify model, partitions, and recovery first
en.intro: OpenWrt or FreshTomato support depends on the exact model and hardware revision. Image names, forum bundles, and similar enclosures cannot replace model-specific install material.

seo.title: Reuse an Old Router with OpenWrt Safely | KitAgain
seo.description: Compare OpenWrt and FreshTomato routes for old routers, then use Xiaomi model leads to verify hardware revision, first install, partitions, and recovery.

sections: Find the exact profile first
Record the bottom label, region, and hardware revision, then resolve the exact profile in the upstream support table or firmware selector.
Xiaomi AX9000, AX3000T, 4A Gigabit, and Redmi AX6S are different targets. A shared brand does not make their images interchangeable.
Separate upgrade from first install
sysupgrade, factory, and initramfs images serve different purposes. Follow only the exact device page's first-install instructions.
A community roundup can discover a model, but it does not replace official device Info, partition layout, boot method, and recovery steps.
FreshTomato applies only to devices in its support scope. Do not infer support for an unlisted model.
Prepare recovery before choosing a job
Save stock configuration and required partitions, then confirm that rescue mode, serial access, or the vendor recovery tool matches the revision.
Verify wired networking, management access, reboot, and rollback before adding routing, Wi-Fi, or extra services.
KitAgain has not compared throughput, coverage, power, or long-term stability on hardware.

zh.intro: OpenBeken、ESPHome 与 Tasmota 都要求准确硬件匹配；同一商品名可能换芯，市电设备还需要合格的断电、隔离与恢复条件。

seo.title: 智能插座本地控制：核对芯片与刷写 | 二手硬件再就业指南 · KitAgain
seo.description: 比较智能插座的 OpenBeken、ESPHome 与 Tasmota 本地控制路线；拆机或刷写前核对准确型号、主控芯片、PCB、地区电气规格和恢复方法。

sections: 先识别内部硬件
核对完整型号、地区电气规格、PCB 与主控芯片；外壳和商品页名称不能证明内部硬件相同。
OpenBeken 面向其文档列出的 BK7231 等芯片，ESPHome 与 Tasmota 则需匹配对应设备配置或模板。
从型号页决定路线
Sonoff S31 与 Shelly Plug S 已有具体型号资料入口，仍需核对当前硬件修订与刷写方式。
Athom 与 Kogan 条目目前是型号级线索；在读取芯片、引脚、刷写和恢复资料前，不把它们当作即刷即用固件。
需要保留电量统计时，还要逐项验证电压、电流、功率和累计值；不能从开关成功推断计量准确。
市电安全与验收
断电并确认隔离后才能打开外壳；不在裸露带电状态下探测，也不由本站替代合格的电气判断。
先备份原始 flash 与校准数据，再分别验证开关、断电恢复、网络失效和本地控制。
本站没有新增安全认证、负载测试、计量校准或长期运行结论。

en.title: Local smart plugs: verify the chip, board, and safety conditions
en.intro: OpenBeken, ESPHome, and Tasmota all require an exact hardware match. A product name may hide a changed chip, and mains devices need safe isolation and a recovery route.

seo.title: Reuse a Smart Plug for Local Control | KitAgain
seo.description: Compare OpenBeken, ESPHome, and Tasmota routes for local smart-plug control; verify the exact model, controller, PCB, and recovery before flashing.

sections: Identify the internal hardware first
Match the complete model, regional electrical specification, PCB, and controller. The enclosure and product-page name do not establish identical internals.
OpenBeken targets documented BK7231-family and other listed chips, while ESPHome and Tasmota require a matching device configuration or template.
Choose from the exact-model page
Sonoff S31 and Shelly Plug S have exact-model source entries, but the current hardware revision and flashing method still need confirmation.
The Athom and Kogan entries remain model-level leads. Do not treat them as flash-ready firmware until chip, pins, flashing, and recovery have been read.
If energy monitoring matters, verify voltage, current, power, and accumulated values separately. A working relay does not prove metering accuracy.
Mains safety and acceptance
Open the enclosure only after disconnecting and isolating power. Never probe exposed energized hardware, and do not treat this guide as qualified electrical judgment.
Back up original flash and calibration data, then test switching, power-loss recovery, network failure, and local control separately.
KitAgain adds no safety certification, load test, metering calibration, or long-term hardware result.
